documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27, driven by core business execution, branch expansion, and scalability. The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to INR325 crore to INR350 crore, supported by healthy bank partnerships and loan disbursements. Development of the AkikoPay digital platform is nearly complete, with apps live on Android and iOS rollout expected within days. Additionally, management highlighted a positive demand outlook, stable receivable days, and robust profitability with expected PAT margins of 9% to 11% for the year. Akiko Global Services Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, driven by its credit card sourcing and lending businesses.

guidance.claim: Management revised the FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins for the year to be between 9% and 11%.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a 70% to 100% year-on-year CAGR for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects 70% to 100% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company has a long-term vision to build INR 1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins to 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: And we have also taken a long-term vision of 2030. We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects AkikoPay revenue of INR 50 crores to INR 100 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: If seen, I am expecting AkikoPay revenue of INR50 crores to INR100 crores in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q1 revenue of around INR 65 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

guidance.claim: Management expects Dubai revenue to reach INR 20 crores in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently growing the fastest among all loan products.
Digital lead generation combined with a physical servicing network significantly improves conversion rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: New branches are lined up to be opened in Indore and Kerala.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities across India.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company increased its branch count from 3 or 4 to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: Unsecured loan payout average stands at 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Branch expansion in previous quarters initially caused profit stress, which has now contributed to profitability.
margins_costs.quote: As I mentioned last time, our profit faced slight stress last quarter because we opened several branches across multiple cities. This time, those branches have contributed to profitability, enabling us to deliver good growth this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Pressure on margins in Q4 was due to planned investments towards branch expansion, technology infrastructure, and the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that. Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Dubai operations experienced temporary margin pressure due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursements currently stand at INR450 crores and 18,000 cards.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we disburse almost 18,000 cards, plus INR450 crores is your monthly loan disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: Management targets reaching approximately INR1,000 crores in monthly loan disbursements by December.
orders_capacity.quote: plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a total employee strength of around 950.
orders_capacity.quote: In the investor deck, it has been mentioned that the employee strength is around odd 950.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The loan business has reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR 400 crores+, amounting to an annual book of INR 5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: The total combined workforce including employees and channel partners has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

capital_allocation.claim: There are no plans for fundraising for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year. That means there is no plan until then.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days are coming down from 133 days to 110 days, and are expected within 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to achieving revenue of INR325 crores to INR350 crores for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to bringing receivable days down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to integrating insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay within the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, in the next quarter, you will see business visibility for insurance and mutual funds within it.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to reaching approximately INR1,000 crores in monthly loan disbursements by December end.
management_commitments.quote: plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to expanding the total employee count to 1,400 to 1,500 in the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that AkikoPay will most likely be live on iOS with all features within this month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual fund and insurance products are expected to go live by August.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets taking the unsecured book to INR 1,000 crores by 31st March.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book. So, the INR400 crores is to be taken to INR1,000 crores. This is my complete vision, complete target till 31st March.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
